MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms that are present in the source document. This is Amendment No. 4 to an existing credit agreement, and the amendment document itself is purely technical in nature - it only corrects language in Section 9.05(g) by inserting ", the Borrower or any of its Restricted Subsidiaries" after "Affiliated Lender."

The source document does not contain the underlying financial terms of the credit facility (loan amounts, interest rates, maturity dates, specific covenant terms, etc.) because this is just a technical amendment document, not the original credit agreement or a substantive modification. The memo correctly notes this limitation by indicating "N/A" for these terms and explicitly stating that "this amendment document does not contain the underlying financial terms of the credit facility."

All material information that is present in the source document has been captured, including:
- Parties (Claros Mortgage Trust, Inc. and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.)
- Amendment effective date (May 5, 2023)
- Original agreement date (August 9, 2019)
- Previous amendment dates
- Governing law (New York State Law)
- Security structure (liens on collateral)
- The specific technical change being made
